sources.title: Law No. 88-025: conditions of foreigner stay in Comoros
sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice of the Union of the Comoros
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Justice Ministry legal-text portal publishes the foreigner-entry law. Article 2 expressly places only the five-day transit visa at an airport or port; it separately defines a 45-day tourist visa, and Articles 1 and 4 preserve treaty/special-law and delegated-issuance exceptions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: un visa de transit ... délivré à l’aéroport ou au port

sources.title: Foreigners services
sources.publisher: Government of the Union of the Comoros
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Government e-Government portal identifies its foreigner-services catalogue and currently reports no services. It publishes neither a short-visitor nationality schedule nor an arrival-issuance result.

unresolved.reason: The current Justice Ministry law makes airport/port issuance explicit only for a five-day transit visa, while it separately defines a 45-day tourist visa and authorizes Interior/consular issuance. It preserves treaties, special laws and category-specific instructions, so it is neither an exhaustive ordinary-tourist visa-on-arrival rule nor a direct prohibition of one. The live Government foreigner-services catalogue has no schedule. No current Comorian primary source maps this ordinary passport to tourist border issuance; no fallback correction is inferred.
